decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 58.20 EUR for the disputed charge only. The disputed charge is TXN-008191 for 58.20 EUR from KESTREL ATHLETIC CLUB on card CRD-000019. It was made on 2026-10-02 and posted on 2026-10-03. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 27 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The merchant issued a written cancellation confirmation, DOC-000096, which says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-15. The cancellation therefore took effect before the charge, so the charge should not have been made (recurring-cancelled-before-charge). The credit is the disputed charge only, and 58.20 EUR is well under the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit (provisional-credit). The cardholder claims 232.80 EUR, covering four months of charges. Earlier charges are not this dispute and are not covered by the cancellation, so the larger claim does not change the amount credited.
